PCI and ED25519 verify workspace types and hardware access function declarations.

# Purpose
This header file declares the interface for a PCI-based hardware workspace used by Wiredancer. It defines constants, PCI stream and workspace data structures, and helper functions for PCI setup, counter access, timestamp reads, and physical address lookup. It also declares the request and response initialization functions and the [`wd_ed25519_verify_req`](<#wd_ed25519_verify_req>) function, which sends an ED25519 signature verification request to the hardware. The file includes FPGA and memory cache headers because it connects software control code with FPGA device access and message buffer handling.
